content.thinking: Two candidates: the spec depends on wall-clock sleep for the drain window, or the queue's flush is genuinely racing the consumer. Reproduce first at a high repetition count before changing anything, and record which of the two it is.

require 'spec_helper'

RSpec.describe Queue, 'under GC stress' do
  it 'drains with eight producers' do
    GC.stress = true
    queue = Queue.new(capacity: 512)
    8.times.map { Thread.new { 500.times { queue.push(rand) } } }.each(&:join)
    expect(queue.drained?).to be true
  ensure

  end
end
